usage: cli.py audit-manifest [-h] --as-of AS_OF --brief BRIEF
                             --brief-meta BRIEF_META --strategy STRATEGY
                             --strategy-meta STRATEGY_META --trace TRACE
                             --trace-meta TRACE_META
                             --diff-strategy DIFF_STRATEGY
                             --diff-strategy-meta DIFF_STRATEGY_META
                             --diff-trace DIFF_TRACE
                             --diff-trace-meta DIFF_TRACE_META --out OUT
                             [--meta-out META_OUT] [--strategy-md STRATEGY_MD]
                             [--diff-strategy-md DIFF_STRATEGY_MD]
                             [--diff-trace-md DIFF_TRACE_MD]
                             [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] [--cache-only]
                             [--refresh] [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --as-of AS_OF         As-of date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --brief BRIEF         Brief JSON path
  --brief-meta BRIEF_META
                        Brief meta JSON path
  --strategy STRATEGY   Strategy JSON path
  --strategy-meta STRATEGY_META
                        Strategy meta JSON path
  --trace TRACE         Trace strategy-brief JSON path
  --trace-meta TRACE_META
                        Trace strategy-brief meta JSON path
  --diff-strategy DIFF_STRATEGY
                        Strategy diff JSON path
  --diff-strategy-meta DIFF_STRATEGY_META
                        Strategy diff meta JSON path
  --diff-trace DIFF_TRACE
                        Trace diff JSON path
  --diff-trace-meta DIFF_TRACE_META
                        Trace diff meta JSON path
  --out OUT             Output manifest JSON path
  --meta-out META_OUT   Optional output manifest meta JSON path
  --strategy-md STRATEGY_MD
                        Optional strategy markdown path
  --diff-strategy-md DIFF_STRATEGY_MD
                        Optional strategy diff markdown path
  --diff-trace-md DIFF_TRACE_MD
                        Optional trace diff markdown path
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        Cache directory
  --cache-only          Fail if cache is missing; do not recompute.
  --refresh             Recompute even if cache exists.
  --no-clobber          Fail if output file already exists.
